answer.text:

Finding an affordable ERP system for a pharmaceutical company that features robust batch/lot tracking and regulatory compliance usually means looking at flexible open-source platforms, modular cloud ERPs, or specialized process-manufacturing add-ons rather than high-end enterprise giants like SAP S/4HANA or Veeva.
Top Affordable ERP Systems with Pharma Batch Tracking
Core Pharma Features to Verify Before Buying
Traceability (Forward & Backward):: The system must instantly trace a finished product lot back to raw material suppliers, or isolate all finished goods affected by a compromised raw material batch.
FEFO Control:: Look for First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) inventory picking rules rather than standard FIFO to prevent expired stock from shipping.
Compliance Support:: Ensure it manages quality control checkpoints, Certificate of Analysis (CoA) generation, and electronic signatures if you require FDA/cGMP alignment.
